data.title: Are You Hungry?
data.statement:
You must find out how hungry you are by looking at the names of the foods you've eaten.

You will get [[n]] names of foods and your maximum food level [[max]].

For every [[food]], its [[foodPoints]] is equal to the position (1-based) of its first letter in the English alphabet. That is, {{A}} = {{1}}, {{B}} = {{2}} and so on, up to {{Z}} = {{26}}.

Your total [[foodPoints]] is the sum of the values of all [[food]] names.

If [[foodPoints]] ≤ {{20%}} of [[max]], output "{{starving...}}".

If {{20%}} of [[max]] < [[foodPoints]] ≤ {{50%}} of [[max]], output "{{Yes, please!}}".

If {{50%}} of [[max]] < [[foodPoints]] ≤ {{85%}} of [[max]], output "{{I wouldn't mind eating something.}}".

If {{85%}} of [[max]] < [[foodPoints]] < [[max]], output "{{Just a little bit.}}".

If [[max]] ≤ [[foodPoints]] ≤ {{115%}} of [[max]], output "{{No thanks, I'm full.}}".

If {{115%}} of [[max]] < [[foodPoints]], output "{{BURSTING!!!}}".

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

You must find out how hungry you are by looking at the names of the foods you've eaten.

You will get n names of foods and your maximum food level max.

For every food, its foodPoints is equal to the position (1-based) of its first letter in the English alphabet. That is, A = 1, B = 2 and so on, up to Z = 26.

Your total foodPoints is the sum of the values of all food names.

If foodPoints ≤ 20% of max, output "starving...".

If 20% of max < foodPoints ≤ 50% of max, output "Yes, please!".

If 50% of max < foodPoints ≤ 85% of max, output "I wouldn't mind eating something.".

If 85% of max < foodPoints < max, output "Just a little bit.".

If max ≤ foodPoints ≤ 115% of max, output "No thanks, I'm full.".

If 115% of max < foodPoints, output "BURSTING!!!".
Input
Line 1: An integer n, the number of foods eaten.

Line 2: An integer max, your maximum food level.

Next n lines: A food name food.
Output
Line 1: The hunger status corresponding to your total foodPoints.
Constraints
0 < n ≤ 50
10 < max ≤ 200

Each food consists of letters without spaces.
The first letter of food is always capitalized.
Example
Input
3
15
Apple
Bagel
CreamCheese
Output
Yes, please!
